sites.name: IM-2 Athena landing point (Mons Mouton region)
sites.coordinate_frame: Lunar Mean Earth/polar axis (ME) body-fixed frame, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude. ASSUMED: the LROC page does not name its frame; LRO products use the ME frame by project convention. Horizons interprets the submitted coordinates in MOON_ME (DE421-based).
sites.coordinate_source_title: LROC: IM-2 Athena Seen Obliquely (M. Robinson, 10 March 2025) - gives 84.7906° S, 29.1957° E
sites.surface_elevation_reference: Height above the 1737.4 km LOLA reference sphere, LDEM_80S_20M (PDS LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0 V2.0) bilinear at the site; consistent with 1131 LOLA RDR shots within ~600 m (DEM - shot mean -0.26 m, sd 0.67 m). The DEM was gridded from LOLA RDR shots, so this checks our reading of the product (scaling, reference, projection, interpolation), not the terrain independently. See data/terrain/im2-athena_site_elevation_report.json.
sites.horizons_altitude_reference: Height above the Horizons reference body for the Moon: a 1737.4 km sphere (response header 'Center radii'), the same reference as LOLA heights.
sites.altitude_conversion_note: horizons_site_altitude_km = (surface_elevation_m + observer_height_above_surface_m) / 1000 = (5321.9 m + 1 m) / 1000 = 5.3229 km. Both heights are relative to the same 1737.4 km sphere, so no datum conversion is needed. Rounding: the bilinear LDEM_80S_20M surface is 5321.8804 m; it was rounded to 0.1 m (5321.9 m) before forming the Horizons altitude, so the submitted point is 1.0196 m above the interpolated surface (nominal 1 m). The terrain horizon uses the same submitted point, so Sun/Earth directions and skyline refer to one observer. Measured effect of the 0.0196 m: skyline <= 0.0034 deg (nearest skyline point 330 m), 1 of 8640 Sun steps (2026-12-30 sunset, one 10-minute step), no demo-window metric change; Sun/Earth directions ~3e-9 deg. No absolute vertical accuracy of the surface value is claimed: LOLA RDR shots near the site (the DEM's own source data) agree with the DEM to mean -0.26 m, sd 0.67 m, max |4.71| m (1131 shots within ~600 m), and the 8 shots within 30 m span 5321.75-5322.69 m; these are consistency and local-spread figures, not an accuracy. Terrain within 100 m of the coordinate spans -4.4 to +4.6 m (a height range, not an uncertainty; the coordinate's accuracy is not stated). Horizons echo: Center geodetic 5.3229 km exactly; |Center cylindric| = 1742.7228895 km, 10.5 mm below 1737.4 + 5.3229 km, explained by the printed precision (Dz is given to 0.1 m), so the echo confirms the radius only to about +/-5 cm.

terrain.source: PDS Geosciences Node, LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0, polar products V2.0 (LOLA data through 2017-02-02)
terrain.rule: Use LDEM_80S_20M wherever the ray is inside it; continue rays that leave it (azimuths ~320-351 deg, 165-190 km) in LDEM_75S_60M. Stop a ray only when terrain at the global LOLA maximum height (+100 m) could no longer exceed the running horizon. If a ray leaves every file first, that azimuth's horizon is null (unknown), never flat.
